title: The Golf Buggy — EN/DE/JA (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar German Japanese language learning dry wit deadpan 102bpm upright bass brushed snare absurdist true story Australian family comedy trilingual
lyrics:
[Verse 1 - English]
December 2025. The Vines Resort.
Jack accelerated by accident into Joel through the gate.
Broken leg. Three laughing emojis from hospital.
That's Joel. That all you got, Jack?

[Verse 2 - German, with English translations]
Dezember 2025. The Vines Resort. (December 2025. The Vines Resort.)
Jack beschleunigte versehentlich in Joel durch das Tor. (Jack accelerated by accident into Joel through the gate.)
Gebrochenes Bein. Drei lachende Emojis aus dem Krankenhaus. (Broken leg. Three laughing emojis from hospital.)
Das ist Joel. Ist das alles was du hast, Jack? (That's Joel. That all you got, Jack?)
Der Golfwagen (The golf buggy)
Jack hinterm Steuer (Jack behind the wheel)
Der Golfwagen (The golf buggy)
Joel durch das Tor (Joel through the gate)

[Chorus - Japanese, with English translations]
ゴルフカート (The golf buggy)
ジャックがハンドルを握る (Jack behind the wheel)
ゴルフカート (The golf buggy)
ジョエルがゲートを通る (Joel through the gate)
ゴルフカート (The golf buggy)
骨折 (Broken leg)
ゴルフカート (The golf buggy)
笑い泣き絵文字三つ (Three laughing emojis)
ゴルフカート (The golf buggy)
それがジョエル (That's Joel)
病院から三つの笑顔 (Three laughing faces from hospital)

[Bridge - all three]
English: "Broken leg. Jack run me over in my golf cart." Then three laughing emojis. That's Joel.
German: "Gebrochenes Bein. Jack hat mich mit meinem Golfwagen umgefahren." Dann drei lachende Emojis. Das ist Joel. (Broken leg. Jack ran me over in my golf cart. Then three laughing emojis. That's Joel.)
Japanese: 「骨折。ジャックがゴルフカートで轢いた。」次に笑い泣き絵文字三つ。それがジョエル。(Broken leg. Jack ran over me in golf cart. Three laughing emojis. That's Joel.)

[Outro - all three]
English: Still kicking — from hospital — three laughing emojis
German: Noch am Kämpfen — aus dem Krankenhaus — drei lachende Emojis (Still kicking — from hospital — three laughing emojis)
Japanese: まだ戦っている — 病院から — 笑い泣き絵文字三つ (Still fighting — from hospital — three laughing emojis)
